metadata.name: Industrialist
metadata.description: Build your own finished goods. Resources, intermediate production chain and ordinary recipes are sold; finished ships/modules/drones/ammunition are Buy-only at snapshot. Production intermediates Sell 150% / Buy 95% Production Cost; raw resources 130% / 60%. Five hubs plus regional suppliers.
